description: A sample and hold: each trigger captures the voltage at the input and holds it at the output until the next trigger

inputs.text: The voltage captured on each trigger; whatever is present at that instant is what gets held
A rising edge through 2V captures the voltage at V.IN; the trigger re-arms once the voltage falls back to 0.1V or below

outputs.text: The voltage captured at the last trigger, held unchanged until the next one

notes: nothing comes out until a trigger arrives at TRIG IN; before the first one the output is 0V.
the module is monophonic. Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and the output carries a single channel.
with the module bypassed, V.IN is passed straight through to V.OUT.

inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
